decisions.reason: The Hero V refinement does not alter the existing requirement that the second V derive from the Hero V's shared geometry; no candidate attribute becomes obsolete or changes.
The source refines only the Hero V's right-arm geometry and does not resume or change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The accent's requirement to derive from Hero V geometry remains valid unchanged; the source does not establish a new accent-specific correspondence or remove an existing attribute.
The source concerns black-and-white structural geometry and does not change the deferred champagne-gold material treatment or its application constraint.
Refining the Hero V's right-arm weight and negative-space construction does not necessarily change the deferred wordmark kerning or rhythm requirements.
